title: Chapter 522
paragraphs: Chapter 522
Episode 143. Attribute Training (3)
Hoo, hoo...
Jin caught his breath and looked up at the ice wall.
Among the chaotic destruction as if some giant beast had rampaged, there was one particularly clean and deep hole.
It was a hole formed by the Light-Speed Thrust he had just unleashed.
Among the Light-Speed Thrusts he had executed over the past two weeks, only the last one had pierced through the wall of solid ice.
The hole was in such a perfect circle that it felt oddly artistic.
The works of great artists often give a feeling as if one could see the soul and obsession spent to create it when observed closely.
The hole formed by Jin's Light-Speed Thrust was the same.
Jin and Talris, who had created the result together, couldn't take their eyes off the hole for a while and remained silent.

"You've completed it, son-in-law. Only half a month to create such a sword... haha, I wonder what Syron would say if he saw this. He would certainly be satisfied. Anyway, I wonder how Syron is doing."
"It's the first time I've seen anyone worrying about my father, Master Talris."
"Well, he's a friend. I also made a promise with your father..."
Talris gave a bitter smile.
Cough!
Just as Jin was about to respond, he suddenly coughed up blood.
"Son-in-law!"
"It seems I've used too much aura and have a minor backlash. You don't need to worry."
"If you were as robust as your first or second sister, you wouldn't have fallen into such a backlash. Haha, you're so frail."
Even though he said this, in reality, Talris was admiring Jin's stamina.
He had just thrown a joke to make Jin stay cautious.
"I think I get a glimpse of what level my sister Luna is at."
"White Bow Luna Runcandel, if her swordsmanship is where I last remember it, you're already technically on par or superior."
Jin shook his head.
"I don't know when Master Talris's last memory is, but I'm sure my sister has also achieved tremendous accomplishments. I think I still have a long way to go to catch up with her."

"She wouldn't have grown as fast as you. And Luna's real strength isn't her incredible physicality or swordsmanship. She... hmm, how should I put it? She always has the ability to win, that seems about right."
"Always has the ability to win...?"

"I'm definitely stronger than Luna. I'm ahead of her in almost every aspect. But if I were to fight Luna, I can't be certain of victory. Your eldest sister has something that's hard to explain with words like potential or talent. Of course, those are also tremendous. And."
Talris turned to Jin and continued.
"While teaching you this time, I saw something similar in you. I believe that it's the greatest blessing a martial artist can have."
"That's a nice thing to hear."
"However, neither you nor Luna got it for free, so there's no need to be complacent."
Just as he was about to express his gratitude for the training, he sensed a presence.
"Jin Gongja!"
It was Kashimir.
As soon as he entered, he couldn't help but be surprised at the state of the ice wall.
He too was momentarily captivated by the single perfect trace amidst the destroyed ice walls.
'Are these traces the result of training? Especially that trace... It seems that Gongja has perfected a new sword.'
It's an ice wall strengthened by the power of solid ice.
Kashimir had a feeling that it wouldn't be easy to create deep cracks in these ice walls with his own sword.
"You've arrived, Commander Kashimir."
"Hmm, I was about to send the son-in-law away today. Did you come to give a hint that I'm holding him too long?"
"No, Master Talris. There's an issue that Gongja needs to check urgently, so I came to find him."
As Kashimir showed a report from the Seven-Colored Bird, Jin's gaze became heavy.
'A prelude to purging?'
Looking at the report with him, Talris chuckled as if it was absurd.
"Ahaha, that emperor. Back in our youth, he used to be very careful about Ron's mood. Although Ron has been soft since before the Sword Emperor City terror, it's unusual for him to be so fearless."
In fact, the royal family's containment of Hailan has been ongoing since their youth.
And as Talris said, as Ron became more gentle, the royal family's containment increased in intensity in proportion.
Ron, like a beast generously dealing with puppies that don't know better, mostly did not react.
Unless it was to incite rebellion, he considered it a way for the empire.
Previous family heads had also done so, and the royal family, knowing this fact, rarely crossed the line.
But this time, they crossed it.
'According to the report, the emperor is deliberately dropping the Imperial Dragon and the Dragon Knights.'
The reason, of course, is to prevent the Dragon Knights from immediately finding Sword Emperor City if something happens to Hailan.
Although the emperor holds the command of the Dragon Knights, they were those who would prioritize the safety of Sword Emperor City over the orders of the Empire when Hailan was in danger.
Even if it means committing treason by disobeying the Emperor's orders.
Of course, with this level of circumstantial evidence, we can't be certain that there will be a purge.

Just as they have always increased the intensity of containment whenever they had the opportunity, they might just be putting on a show for the public, using the Sword Emperor City terror and its aftermath, to reveal that the power of the royal family is absolute.
But Jin thought otherwise.
'So the Empire has chosen the stone over Hailan.'
The white stone that the heads of Hailan have been protecting.
The royal family has coveted that stone for a long time.
Just as Elona Zipel is sealed in the Secret Palace, Hailan has also been passing down the white stone to future generations, so that the strongest head can eliminate it.
Jin didn't know what the white stone was.
He could only speculate that it might be related to chaos.
One thing was certain, though.
They had clearly made a mistake.
'Madmen. I don't know how great that stone is, but would they discard the Empire's strongest martial artist like this?'
Ron's Sword Emperor City was the strongest in the history of Hailan.
Despite the unexpected damage in this terror attack, as long as Ron and the key members are intact, the fact that Hailan is the Empire's best martial family does not change.

Until Kinzel rose in this generation, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that the Empire was able to enjoy the position of the third power after Runcandel and Zipel because Ron and Hailan he led existed.

'I asked Beradin to properly use Zipel to pressure Hailan, to confirm the distinction between Pia and the royal family's intentions more clearly. Judging by their actions, the result is practically out. Bement chose the stone and Zipel over Hailan.'
The strange thing was, Ron was not reacting yet.
Despite the signs of a purge that the Seven-Colored Bird's informants could know.

"Hmm, the royal family must have some basis for belief to be doing this. I can't figure it out. Putting aside whether they have a reason to purge Hailan in the first place, how do they plan to deal with Ron?"
Talris thought that the royal family, even if it was 'attached to Zipel', couldn't easily use Zipel's power to deal with Ron.
It would be nothing more than advertising that the royal family sold the empire to Zipel.
"...As Master Talris said, there seems to be something they believe in."
"It's almost as if they have Dante hostage. Hmm, the son-in-law seems quite worried."
"Yes."

"Even though the Sword Emperor City terror has tarnished the dignity, any martial artist who lived in that time would rather worry about the royal family and the empire. Even if Runcandel collectively goes mad and threatens to purge your father, would you worry about public opinion?"
That's a valid point.
If Ron were in a normal state, Jin would not have worried at all whether the Emperor tied up the Knight's feet or borrowed Zipel's power.

-I'm not sure if it was the red sword energy that was the problem, or if there was another factor. If the day comes when I suffer such uncontrollable internal injuries, I naturally thought it would be the day I crossed swords with your father... It's shocking to think that the leader of a group known as a third-rate terrorist organization until recently.
Immediately after the Sword Emperor City terror, Jin heard separately about Ron's internal injuries.
He failed to recover from the injuries he sustained in the battle at that time.
It's normal for a superhuman like Ron to recover quickly, but his internal injuries gradually worsened over time.
Even Dante didn't know this fact.
It was a story only known to Jin and Ron's five closest confidants.
'...Perhaps the Emperor might have noticed the condition of Lord Ron.'
It didn't seem like he was certain that Ron was not yet normal.
'If they fully understood Lord Ron's condition, they wouldn't be testing the waters like this, they would have charged in all at once.'
Jin also didn't know Ron's current state precisely. Whether Ron's injury is at a similar level to the beginning, or if it has worsened.
That made Jin anxious.
The fact that Ron has not reacted so far (or perhaps he is responding but the information has not been relayed to him) must be related to his condition.
"You're right. But I still have to go to the Sword Emperor City myself."
"Yes, yes. Go and show off some new secret technique."
"From now on, if anyone asks, I will announce that I have learned one secret technique of Runcandel from Master Talris. It was an honorable lesson, Master Talris."
"Anyway, you're cute. Ah, and if you see anything, if something bad seems to be happening at the Sword Emperor City, be sure to let me know."
"I will."
As soon as Jin left the Secret Palace with Kashimir, he immediately boarded a Tikan portal heading to the Empire.
And the portal did not activate, only triggering an alarm.
This was a phenomenon that occurred when the portal on the other end was closed.
